title: Identity continuity and ARIA evidence proof

claims.text: Same path under different repo names (CortexV5CI vs CortexTeach) are separate durable memory namespaces; check with cortex identity before merging doctrine.
Bootstrap verified and block false do not mean evidence selection is strong; ARIA-active tasks must materialize deferred substrate and surface implementation proof.
Discovery Cards teach interconnect law but must not monopolize ARIA-active packets over ARIA-RUNTIME/CONNECT, purpose docs, and cortex/*.py implementation.
ARIA remains dormant on generic tasks; only typed wake materializes bulk — still never auto-executes plans or grants mutation rights.

claim_boundary: Identity and evidence-selection doctrine; never mutation authority.
